personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, editorial-driven premium dark theme that feels like high-end French nutrition coaching.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Let typography and glassmorphism breathe. Use lg/xl margins heavily to keep a cinematic feel.

do's: Use heavy translucent glass for sticky headers, bottom tab bar, and bottom sheet handles.
Use expo-blur on featured meal cards overlaid on food photography.
Ensure a dark tint backing behind the blur so text remains legible.
dont's: Don't blur dense data input sections (like macro configuration sliders).
Don't apply glass to basic list rows.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium dashboard showing today's meal plan and a snapshot of current progress.

states.empty: Elegant prompt to start a new weekly program.
states.error: Muted error text with a retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero card with full-bleed food imagery and glassmorphism overlay showing today's current meal. Below, an elegant weight progression mini-chart. Horizontal scroll for weekly timeline. Sticky bottom tab bar with glass effect.

screens.name: Planner
screens.purpose: Weekly meal planner view and configuration hub.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty plate prompting to generate a plan.

screens.layout: Vertical timeline of day cards. Each card can expand to show specific macros. A sticky, glass-backed 'Generate/Edit Plan' FAB at the bottom right. Tapping the FAB opens a Gorhom bottom sheet for adjusting targets via sliders, selecting program duration, and toggling rules (e.g., max fruit/day).

screens.name: Inventory
screens.purpose: Manage pantry, fridge, and freezer with priority tagging.
screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Frigo / Congélateur / Placards). List layout for items. Items have a sleek right-aligned toggle (⚡ Priorité) using the warning (antique gold) token to highlight items to eat first.

screens.name: Cooking Mode
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of the dish. A heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top to bottom) overlays it. Oversized display serif (Fraunces) for the recipe name. Scrollable step-by-step instructions. A sticky primary CTA at the bottom to mark as 'Completed'.

empty_state_plate.alt: Minimalist empty plate on dark wood table

pantry_bg.alt: Fresh organic vegetables on dark surface

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is strictly French for all UI text, as requested ('Mon plan alimentaire').
Applies Glass / Luxe DARK personality. Do NOT use standard Material UI cards or harsh shadows.
BANNED: No blues, no purples, no indigos. The palette uses deep obsidian backgrounds, sage/moss green as the primary brand color, and antique gold as a warning/highlight accent.

Use a vertical top-to-bottom three-stop linear gradient scrim over all images (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 80%+ surfaceInverse). Text layered on top must strictly use onSurfaceInverse to guarantee readability.
For complex configuration sections (e.g., target nutritional settings by meal and food categories, weekly length settings), strongly prefer Gorhom bottom sheets over cluttering main views.
Use the 'empty_state_plate' image for zero-data states, paired with an elegant display font header.
All primary CTA buttons pinned to the bottom of the screen must sit within a fixed container (clear of the scroll view) over a glass-blurred background or solid 'surface' background.
